title: Fire Damages Six Businesses Along Highway in Nuevo Laredo
excerpt: A fire damaged six businesses at kilometer 25 of the National Highway in Nuevo Laredo. No one was hurt, and firefighters kept the flames from spreading.
content:
A fire damaged six businesses along the National Highway in Nuevo Laredo on Sunday, according to KGNS.

The fire broke out at kilometer 25 of the Carretera Nacional, KGNS reported. Six businesses were damaged, though the report did not name them or put a dollar figure on the damage.

No one was hurt, according to KGNS.

Merchants and a firefighter inspection point to an electrical short circuit as the possible cause, KGNS reported, but the cause has not been officially confirmed.

Twelve firefighters responded with two fire engines, three official water tankers and one outside support tanker, and kept the flames from spreading to other businesses, according to KGNS.

Source: KGNS, November 15, 2026.
